name: ChoiceRow
description:
A checkbox, radio or switch with its own label and description beside it (the
controls' `label` prop). A native label points at the control, so clicking the text
toggles it; works inside or outside a Field.
signature: ({ controlId, label, description, disabled, className, children, }: ChoiceRowProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: children
props.description: The checkbox, radio or switch. Give it `id={controlId}` and `aria-describedby={descriptionId(controlId)}`.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: controlId
props.description: The control's id (the label points at it).

props.name: description
props.description: Additional content describing the value, state, or consequence.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables interaction while retaining the component’s disabled appearance.

props.name: label
props.description: The visible or accessible label for this component.
